question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Debased
solution:
The correct answer is: **Corrupted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**debased**' means to reduce in quality or value. (गुणवत्ता या मूल्य में कमी करना)
 
• The synonym for '**debased**' is '**corrupted**', which means to spoil or contaminate. (ख़राब या दूषित करना)
